_comment: Curated waypoints (agent-curated 2026-09-05, human-editable). Pipeline anchors each lat/lon to trail chainage and emits derived/viewer/waypoints.json. kinds: poi | junction | obstacle. Sources: 4x4explore.com trail description, YouTube search results (embed IDs only), MVUM spur geometry, DEM analysis. Obstacle<->description mapping is approximate where noted; refine after field visits.

waypoints.title: North trailhead — historic Bunce School (CO-7)
waypoints.notes: 1888 schoolhouse at the highway junction. Trail runs 5.08 mi south to Peaceful Valley. MVUM: open yearlong, ATV open, high-clearance. Full-trail videos anchored here.

media.title: Offroad Fun on Bunce School Road (2019)

waypoints.title: FR 115.1A — Bunce School Spur
waypoints.notes: Right at the start heading south; dead-ends at private property within ~0.5 mi (4x4explore). MVUM: yearlong, 0.36 mi.

waypoints.title: FR 217.1 — Cave Creek
waypoints.notes: Heads toward Highway 72 (4x4explore). Not maintained for passenger cars.

waypoints.title: FR 216.1 — Ironclads (hard side trail)
waypoints.notes: Significantly harder than Bunce proper — reports suggest lifted + 35s, steep ledges, spotter useful. Access toward the 1965 T-33 plane crash site. Separate trail; out of scope for this model.

media.title: Wheeling Through History: the T-33 Crash Site (2023)

waypoints.title: Hairpin #1 (rocky)
waypoints.notes: 105-degree hairpin (geometry-detected). 4x4explore: rocky sections concentrate at the hairpins. Description-to-location mapping approximate.

waypoints.title: Steepest sustained pitch (21% max grade, mile ~3.1)
waypoints.notes: DEM-derived: steepest zone on the route. Obstacle candidate — top capture priority. Interesting: matches 4x4explore's 'rocky sections ~2/3 through' better than the hairpins do.

waypoints.title: Hairpin #2 (rocky, pick your line)
waypoints.notes: 119-degree hairpin at mile ~2.65 (geometry-detected), coincides with the steep zone's south end.

waypoints.title: FR 202.1 — Upper Basin (Park Creek)
waypoints.notes: Right intersection near the route's south end (4x4explore calls it Park Creek).

waypoints.title: Descent switchback (upper)
waypoints.notes: 138-degree turn starting the final descent to Peaceful Valley.

waypoints.title: Descent switchback (lower) — roughest section
waypoints.notes: 142-degree turn. 4x4explore: second hairpin 'much rougher', larger rocks, pick your line, just before crossing back near private property.

waypoints.title: South trailhead — Peaceful Valley
waypoints.notes: Camp Dick / Peaceful Valley campgrounds nearby; dispersed sites along the route's NE end.
